english_classification.chapter_title: The Chapter of the Commandments of Righteousness
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter contains no oldest teaching substrate. It is entirely institutional material prescribing community rules for the Manichaean elect (three seals: continence, rest of hands, purity of mouth) and catechumens (fasting, prayer, almsgiving; giving persons to the church; building for the church). Teaching purity is near zero (0.033). The only cosmological term ('Cross of Light' in ¶1) is used as a reference point for a behavioral commandment, not as part of a cosmic-correspondential mapping. The chapter's voice is consistently prescriptive — it tells people what to DO, never describes what cosmic structures ARE. The massive institutional vocabulary drift (5.78→30.12) confirms the chapter is a single institutional composition, not substrate with editorial overlay.
